title: ProviderAvailability
description: What a provider currently has free, where, and when. Published by the provider and read by the matching, so that allocation happens on data rather than on a sequence of phone calls. Same discriminator as ProviderCapability: capability is the standing declaration, availability is the perishable one. plannedRoute and detourToleranceKm sit on the same record because preferring a job that fits a route already being driven, and pricing the detour, is a single decision.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the provider organisation eVault

providerEName.description: eName of the provider organisation offering the capacity

providerType.description: What kind of service the capacity is for. Matches the providerType of the provider's ProviderCapability.

personEName.description: eName of the specific person this availability is about — an operator's shift, a driver's window — where it is person-level rather than company-, asset- or site-level. May be set together with assetEName, which is how 'this operator, in this truck, until the end of the shift' is expressed as one record.

assetEName.description: eName of the specific Vehicle this availability is about, where it is vehicle-level rather than company-level: a service vehicle (a Vehicle with a ServiceVehicle profile in the same eVault) or a company-owned Vehicle with no service role. The field keeps its historical name.

validUntil.description: When the capacity stops being available. The matching ignores it afterwards.

position.description: Where the free capacity is right now

reportedAt.description: When the position was last reported

operatingRadiusKm.description: How far from position the provider will travel for a job, in kilometres

shiftEndsAt.description: Matching must not offer a job that cannot be finished within the shift

freeUnits.description: Trucks free, slots free, seats free or vehicles free, depending on providerType

plannedRoute.description: Stops the provider is already committed to driving. A job that fits one of these is cheaper than a dedicated trip.

sequence.description: Order of the stop on the route, starting at 0

address.description: Street address of the stop, as a person would write it

windowStart.description: Earliest time the provider will be at the stop

windowEnd.description: Latest time the provider will be at the stop

stopType.description: What the provider does at the stop

detourToleranceKm.description: How far off the planned route the provider will divert

earliestIntakeAt.description: Repair providers: the first slot at which a vehicle can be taken in

capacityPerDay.description: Repair providers: the capacity calendar, split by type of work

date.description: The day the capacity is for

workType.description: Type of work the slots are for, such as diagnosis, mechanical or bodywork

slotsTotal.description: Number of slots for this type of work that day

slotsFree.description: Number of those slots still free

locationEnvelopeId.description: ServiceLocation this availability is offered at, for providers with more than one site

status.description: active while the capacity is offered. withdrawn takes it out of the matching before validUntil.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
